### Phase 1 progress: timing instrumentation (baseline-capable)

- Recon (four read-only subagent maps + direct reads) established the actual critical path: per bakeoff round every non-excluded candidate is re-promoted, re-built, re-contrast-audited, re-captured at 3 viewports + authored pages, and re-judged with ~10 high-detail images; the round loop repairs one candidate per round and re-evaluates everything; the visual gate is a separate child process per round. Round dirs `round-00..10` on the #158 acceptance reflect that loop exhausting budgets.
- New `scripts/creative-timing.mjs`: recorder with `record`/`time`, per-category summaries, structured `launchloomTiming` log line. `scripts/report-creative-timings.mjs`: reads a QA `.launchloom` dir (`pipeline-test-report.json` stages, `creative-repair/timing.json`, per-round bakeoff reports, `repair-usage.json`) and can `--compare` two runs with stage/creative/call deltas.
- Wired durations without behavior change: judge + diversity evaluators now return `durationMs`/`attempts` (whole logical call incl. retries); creative repair usage records gain `durationMs`/`attempts`; bakeoff records per-candidate phase timings (`source`, `promote`, `build`, `contrast`, `capture`, `authored-pages`, `judge`) into `candidate.timings` + `report.timings`; orchestrator writes `creative-repair/timing.json` (bakeoff/gate/repair/entries) and flushes it as entries are recorded so failed runs keep the data.
- Tests: `tests/creative-timing.test.ts` (6), `tests/report-creative-timings.test.ts` (3), new assertions in `tests/rendered-creative-repair.test.ts` (54 passed incl. timing.json entries) and `tests/creative-promotion.test.ts` (bakeoff report timings; full suite 22 passed). Also green: creative-repair-loop, creative-judge-runtime, openrouter-cache-integration (142 tests), generation-cost-summary, inference-client, creative-repair-experiment.
